title: Intake
description: One-shot two-round user intake for a run: research question, execution enhancements, depth, optional enhancement mappings, Frame boundary hints, and wrap-up confirmation. User answers only mode and questions; the agent infers the rest. Non-question preferences live in ~/.eduevidence/prefs.json (see definitions.Prefs) and never record the research question. All five report themes stay rendered; default_main_theme only selects which one to open.

research_question.description: Canonical research question collected in round 1. Stored on the run, never in prefs.

enhancements.description: Execution enhancements selected in round 1. Use ["none"] when the user enables nothing.

depth.description: Resolved complexity depth after auto rules (S quick check / M standard / L deep).

depth_choice.description: What the user picked in round 1. auto means the agent applies the depth guideline.

depth_rationale.description: Why depth resolved to S/M/L (auto guideline or explicit choice).

mcp.description: Round-2 Agent MCP block. Present only when agent_mcp is selected.

role_mapping.description: role -> {cli, model} authorization table confirmed by the user.

jev.description: Round-2 Jev block. Present only when jev is selected.

semdecide.description: Round-2 SemDecide block. Present only when semdecide is selected.

frame_hints.description: Background deep-dive boundary hints (population / intervention / comparison / primary_outcome / context). Inferred values are proposals only; unknown fields stay absent (never fabricated).

summary_confirmed.description: Wrap-up summary accepted once; the run then continues unattended.

open_browser.description: Whether to open the main report in a browser when the run finishes.

default_main_theme.description: Which of the five baked themes to open as the main report. All five remain rendered.

prefs_path.description: Absolute path of the prefs file written for this intake (never contains the research question).

Prefs.title: Prefs
Prefs.description: Durable non-question preferences at ~/.eduevidence/prefs.json. Never store a research question here.
